chunks: Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥakam, from al-Ḥusayn ibn ʿUthmān, from Samāʿah, who said:
I asked him about a woman when she dies, so he said: Her husband puts his hand beneath her shirt and washes her up to the elbows.

key_terms.الْمَرْأَةِ: the woman, specifically the deceased wife under discussion

ai.seo_question: Can a husband wash his wife after her death in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the husband’s washing of his deceased wife. It indicates that he may place his hand beneath her garment and wash her up to the elbows, showing a juristic allowance connected to funerary ghusl between spouses.
